messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Automated alert — smoke-check-eu3 failed 5x in a row (eu-west-1). Severity: P2. Paging oncall. probe_id=smoke-check-eu3 region=eu-west-1

pagerduty: Triggered PagerDuty alert PD-46231 for service: synthetic-probes. Summary: smoke-check-eu3 consecutive failures.

sre-oncall: Acked. Taking ownership. @mike.k @anya — triage started. :eyes:

mike.k: seeing 502s from the probe runner? quick check: `curl -s -D - \"https://smoke-eu3.redwood-synth/api/health\" -o /dev/null | head -n 1` returns `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway`

anya: checking loadbalancer logs now. if LB is 502 maybe upstream returning 5xx. pulling last 5 mins.

sean: fyi support reports a slight uptick in 502s for a small subset of sessions starting ~00:07UTC. not widespread.

sre-oncall: runbook stages: 1) confirm probe failure 2) disable probe fanout 3) check router/target pool 4) mitigate (reroute/scale) 5) notify customers if required. I'll disable fanout now to stop noisy pages.

sre-oncall: `curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/maintenance/probe/disable -d '{"probe":"smoke-check-eu3"}'` -> 200 ok. fanout disabled.

incident-bot: Maintenance: smoke-check-eu3 fanout disabled by sre-oncall.

anya: LB logs show increased 502 rate to 1.2% for the smoke endpoint; upstream task pool showing spike in transient connection resets to a single backend host ip 10.4.32.18.

mike.k: can we pull container metrics for 10.4.32.18? `kubectl -n inference top pod --selector=ip=10.4.32.18` — CPU ~92%, mem normal. sounds like CPU saturation.

sean: rolling restarts for that host would likely drop sessions. prefer cordon & drain then reboot; need approval?

product-ops: What's customer impact? support-bot, any active tickets?

support-bot: Creating internal incident note: Support ticket #3278 referenced intermittent 502s in EU; affected tenant count ~3, requests impacted ~0.08% of total in last 10m. Notified CS.

sre-oncall: impact assessment: currently localized to eu-west-1 smoke endpoint and small subset of users hitting that backend. Overall platform error-rate +0.05% system-wide. Recommend mitigations: drain pod 10.4.32.18, scale up replica count for that deployment by +2, monitor for drop in 502s.

anya: scaling up now: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/runtime-eu --replicas=6` -> accepted. also issuing cordon/drain on node nod-eu-12 hosting pod 10.4.32.18.

mike.k: drain started, pod terminating. will restart node after drain.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-46231 acknowledged by sre-oncall.

pagerduty: Auto-escalation suppressed (ack received).

sean: scaling triggered additional replicas, new pods created on other nodes. early telemetry: 502 rate down to 0.3% in last 1m (smoke endpoint).

mike.k: pod on nod-eu-12 evicted. node reboot scheduled.

anya: post-scale LB errors trending toward baseline. upstream host 10.4.32.18 was clearly the hotspot; likely stuck event loop or runaway CPU. will file follow-up for debugging.

product-ops: Any need to contact affected customers? CS suggested we notify 3 tenants about a brief 5–7 min blip.

sre-oncall: impact window 00:07–00:14 UTC, small error spike. I approve a small customer note via CS. No SLA breach expected.

support-bot: Noted. Drafting message for the three tenants: brief outage, root cause suspected backend CPU saturation, mitigated by draining node and scaling replicas.

mike.k: after drain/restart node came back healthy. CPU normalized. no further 502s from that host.

sean: recommending follow-up: 1) increase CPU request for runtime-eu pods 2) investigate long-tail request causing CPU burn 3) add better circuit breakers on LB for single-host surge.

anya: created jira INF-9921: investigate CPU runaway on node nod-eu-12; assigned to eng-runtime.

sre-oncall: handing off to next oncall @anya for slow follow-up and RCA. I'll update PD and close when follow-up ticket confirmed.

incident-bot: Handoff: sre-oncall -> anya. Incident in monitoring state.

pagerduty: Resolving PD-46231 as acknowledged and mitigated.

anya: marking thread resolved for now. leaving notes in runbook and linking INF-9921. will reopen if errors recur. :white_check_mark:

mike.k: thanks. lesson: smoke checks amplify single-host failures quickly. good we had fanout disable ability.

product-ops: +1 on adding per-host throttles for probes.

support-bot: CS notifications queued for manual send after review (templates attached).

sre-oncall: closing thread. good cross-team response, quick mitigation.
